facts.F21: Cross-layer algebra. Domain: roles SystemAdmin, TeamAdmin, PortfolioAdmin, Viewer and UnitAdmin (new, 4); scopes System, Team(id), Portfolio(id) and AllUnits (new, 3, null ScopeId); operations Reaches, RoleOn, SystemRole, CanRead, CanWrite; observation is the read or write answer for a principal on a unit. Application: Success, Refusal (invalid pair, duplicate equal row, caller not System Admin), Conflict (stale or missing switch token) and Error (failed read). Adapter: EF optimistic concurrency on the switch row; a null ScopeId is not unique in the index on SQLite or PostgreSQL, so twins are representable. Infrastructure: a restore without the switch row reads as off and the idempotent seeder adds it again; enums stored as ints, so a rollback meets unknown values and fails closed; no retry, replay or queue.

facts.F29: Claim-to-checker. EffectiveAccess, AppliesTo, the valid-pairs table and the key intersection are total functions over the closed enums UserRole and PermissionScopeType: totality is checked by the C# compiler (a switch over the enum without a default fails the build under TreatWarningsAsErrors) and the laws by exhaustive NUnit tables over every pair; no formal checker is selected for them because the domain is finite and exhaustively enumerated. The two concurrent write protocols, noLostSwitchWrite (switch PUT under its concurrency token including the no-row upsert) and removalLeavesNoTwin (rule creation racing with removal of all twins), are state-model safety claims: Quint is selected, model docs/feature/epic-6577-system-wide-access/models/system_wide_access_writes.qnt. Both stay INDETERMINATE under the recorded maintainer waiver until the model is run. Agda is not selected (no proof beyond finite tables). TLA+ and TLC are not selected: no liveness or fairness claim exists.
